name: Reclaimed Treasures
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I had myself a fine job as a digger at the Uldaman excavation site in the Badlands... that is until those blasted troggs showed up.  I escaped with my hide barely intact, and nothing else.  In the chaos, I left my most treasured possession.  It's safe from the troggs in my chest, sure, but it's right in the thick of 'em.

I'd be in your debt, both in honor and coin, if you could fetch it for me!  A chest with my name on it is at the end of the North Common Hall.  That's the one you need to get in.
narrative.objectives: Get Krom Stoutarm's treasured possession from his chest in the North Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, I feel complete again - thank you kindly.

Some dwarves may treasure the luster of metal, and some may treasure the glint of gems... but a Stoutarm without a treasured stein in hand is hardly a Stoutarm at all!
narrative.requestItemsText: Well now, we're you able to get slap around those troggs long enough to get into my chest and nab my treasure?
